description: Lightweight Music Server. Access your self-hosted music using a web interface.
readme_preview:
_LMS_ is a self-hosted music streaming software: access your music collection from anywhere using a web interface!

A [demo instance](http://lms-demo.poupon.dev) is available. Note the administration settings are not available.

* [Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API](SUBSONIC.md) support * Multi-valued tags: `genre`, `mood`, `artists`, ... * Artist relationships: `composer`, `conductor`, `lyricist`, `mixer`, `performer`, `producer`, `remixer` * [Release...
